encode_text_with_gpt2_bpe: create a GPT2BPE encoder and encode a string into space-separated BPE token IDs
decode_gpt2_bpe_tokens: create a GPT2BPE encoder and decode space-separated BPE token IDs back into text
check_beginning_of_word: use GPT2BPE is_beginning_of_word to check if a token starts a new word
configure_gpt2_bpe: create a GPT2BPEConfig dataclass with custom paths to encoder.json and vocab.bpe files
register_gpt2_bpe_encoder: register the GPT2BPE class as a BPE encoder using the register_bpe decorator
